translationRepairs: In the first month of Guangda year 2 (567) he was made grand tutor while keeping the ministry of education, granted extraordinary honors and the right to wear sword and shoes in audience, and his fief was raised with the former total to three thousand households.

In the first month of Guangda year 2 (568) he was made grand tutor while keeping the ministry of education, granted extraordinary honors and the right to wear sword and shoes in audience, and his fief was raised with the former total to three thousand households.
On dingyou day Bongong, Prince of Jin'an, pacify east general and administrator of Wu, was made central protector and promoted to pacify south general.
On dingyou day Bogong, Prince of Jin'an, pacify east general and administrator of Wu, was made central protector and promoted to pacify south general.
伯恭 is romanized Bogong; "Bongong" is a typo.
On jiachen day in the ninth month Bongong, Prince of Jin'an and newly named central protector, was made central commandant.
On jiachen day in the ninth month Bogong, Prince of Jin'an and newly named central protector, was made central commandant.
伯恭 is romanized Bogong; "Bongong" is a typo.
On jiaxu day Xu Shan took Luzhou commandery city.
On jiaxu day Xu Shan took Lujiang commandery city.

On xinsi day an edict moved Huang Faqu, campaign north grand general, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and inspector of South Yuzhou, to garrison Liyang and restored counties Northern Qi had raised to commanderies.

On xinsi day an edict moved Huang Faqu, campaign south grand general, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and inspector of South Yuzhou, to garrison Liyang and restored counties Northern Qi had raised to commanderies.
In the sixth month, on gengzi day, Li Zong, inspector of Yingzhou, took Shunkou city.
In the sixth month, on gengzi day, Li Zong, inspector of Yingzhou, took Shekou city.
On guimao day Shen Junli, right ministerial aide, minister of personnel, and commandant of horse for the consort, died.
On guiwei day Shen Junli, right ministerial aide, minister of personnel, and commandant of horse for the consort, died.

On renxu day Wang Chang, ministerial aide, was made left ministerial aide; Lu Chuan, grand mentor of the heir apparent and senior rectifier of Yangzhou, was made right ministerial aide; and Xu Ling, director of the directorate of education, was made general of the garrison army.

On renxu day Wang Chang, ministerial aide, was made left ministerial aide; Lu Shan, grand mentor of the heir apparent and senior rectifier of Yangzhou, was made right ministerial aide; and Xu Ling, director of the directorate of education, was made general of the garrison army.
陸繕 is romanized Lu Shan.
On jiayin day Lu Chuan, right ministerial aide, was made left ministerial aide; Wang Ke, newly appointed administrator of Jinling, was made right ministerial aide.
On jiayin day Lu Shan, right ministerial aide, was made left ministerial aide; Wang Ke, newly appointed administrator of Jinling, was made right ministerial aide.
陸繕 is romanized Lu Shan.
In the fifth month, on gengyin day, Wang Yang, left ministerial aide, died.
In the fifth month, on gengyin day, Wang Chang, left ministerial aide, died.
王瑒 is romanized Wang Chang, as elsewhere in this chapter.
In the eleventh month, on xinchou day, General Who Pacifies the West Sun Yu was appointed inspector of Yingzhou.
In the eleventh month, on xinchou day, General Who Pacifies the West Sun Yang was appointed inspector of Yingzhou.
孫瑒 is Sun Yang, as earlier in the chapter.
former Feng Province inspector Gao Wenqin led three thousand foot and horse toward Yangping commandery.
former Feng Province inspector Gao Wenzou led three thousand foot and horse toward Yangping commandery.
皋文奏 is Gao Wenzou; 奏 is read zou, not qin.
An General of the Right and Danyang governor Xu Ling was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and concurrently Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent;
General Pacifying the Right and Danyang governor Xu Ling was made Supervisor of the Secretariat and concurrently Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent;
安右將軍 is General Pacifying the Right, and 中書監 is the Supervisor of the Secretariat, not of the Masters of Writing.

When the Liang house fell into disorder the Huainan lands all passed to Qi; in the first years of Taikian the High Ancestor set his will on recovering the old borders, deployed divine strategy, gave the command, and marched out—victories and captures followed in succession until invaded lands were regained; the achievement was indeed splendid.

When the Liang house fell into disorder the Huainan lands all passed to Qi; in the first years of Taijian the High Ancestor set his will on recovering the old borders, deployed divine strategy, gave the command, and marched out—victories and captures followed in succession until invaded lands were regained; the achievement was indeed splendid.

Emperor Shizu knew the heir was mild and weak and could not bear the throne; the High Ancestor stood in the place of the Duke of Zhou, and Emperor Shizu kept Taibo in heart—and when he was displeased, all great affairs were entrusted to him.

Emperor Shizu knew the heir was mild and weak and could not bear the throne; the High Ancestor stood in the place of the Duke of Zhou, and Emperor Shizu kept Taibo in heart—and when he fell ill, all great affairs were entrusted to him.
弗悆 means to be unwell, describing Emperor Shizu falling ill, not being displeased.
